answer: Proposal: split-neutral staking plus a burned per-identity fee. Each epoch pays strictly in proportion to stake locked for that whole epoch, no per-account bonus; every registered identity also pays a small burned fee. Splitting one stake across aliases falcon, willow and garden yields the same total as a single account, minus extra fees, so clones add cost and nothing else. Enforcement is on-chain escrow and burn, no trusted issuer. Limit: capital still buys proportional sway — this stops cheap clones, not rich ones.
